blocks.doc: Opener lockup "<pre> [logo] <name>": the words slide in, the logo springs, an optional badge bubble pops, a sub line fades in
A big statement: 1–3 lines with an *accent* phrase, optional kicker label above and sub line below; words rise in one by one
Headline over a row of characters that spring up one after another and keep hopping (two rows on portrait)
A hero (character or logo) with 2–5 satellites (icon + label) flying out to it, joined by moving dotted lines; headline above
Headline beside a hero surrounded by orbiting app tiles in three rings; the tiles fling outward on a zoom-out exit
A big number that counts up (with ticks) and lands with a pop, a label under it and an optional sub line
Your own image or footage (live action, screen recording) full-bleed or in a phone/browser frame, with a slow Ken Burns move and an optional headline over a soft scrim
Closing lockup: logo + name, a tagline, CTA buttons, an optional URL and an optional row of characters hopping in
A phone running a UI flow (chat, cards, taps, toasts, agent steps, screenshots) beside a headline (above it on portrait)
A desktop browser / app window running a UI flow (with a mouse cursor for taps), headline above it
A floating UI panel (no device) running UI items
A big prompt box: placeholder → the task is typed with key ticks → send → optional agent steps tick off below

shots.headline: Meet Cue
shots.note: Stand-in logo mark until the Manus brand kit (official Cue logo SVG).

shots.headline: Your own team of *AI agents.*
shots.note: Built-in original characters stand in for Cue's characters.

shots.headline: *8 AM.* Inbox, cleared.
shots.note: Claim: each agent has its own email (confirm).

shots.headline: *11 AM.* A call, handled.
screen: header “Cue” — On a call for you
message “Calling the airline about your seat.”
shots.note: Claim: each agent has its own phone number (confirm).

shots.headline: *1 PM.* Dinner, booked.
shots.note: Claim: Cue only spends after you approve (confirm).

shots.headline: *4 PM.* A trip, planned.
screen: prompt box types “Plan a Lisbon weekend for 4” and sends
agent steps Flights compared ✓ · Hotel shortlisted ✓ · Shared in the group chat ✓
shots.note: Claim: a team of agents splits one job (confirm).

shots.headline: *7 PM.* Pickup, ordered.
screen: notification “Groceries on the way: Arriving 8–9 PM”

shots.headline: Cue
screen: end card “Your own team of AI agents.”
buttons Get it on iOS / Get it on Android
shots.note: Stand-in logo + characters; app stores and URL to confirm.
